question: Can the native generator produce and independently verify synthetic curve/PDP/scalar records and preserve all emitted artifacts through immutable S3 publication and replay, while retaining unsupported and incomplete outcomes?

claims.text: Every record marked verified has its stated known-answer, PDP or independent scalar witness replayed against the exact declared curve and factor base; these are separate labels.
No speedup, fastest-solver, instruction-count completeness, security or asymptotic claim is made.
No exact first/last fall degree or universal fall-degree conjecture is decided by this pilot.

literature.claim: Closure-space first and last fall degrees differ from solver observed degrees; zero-dimensionality hypotheses matter.
literature.verified_by: Read definitions and ECDLP applicability discussion before implementation.

literature.claim: PKM concerns prime-field algebraic attacks; an audit score is not a complete solve.
literature.verified_by: Verified author, bibliographic and abstract record; full publisher paper was not fetched.

literature.claim: Use actual native engines and preserve their parameter and trace limits.

arms.description: Bounded native data generation; method ID is a crossed annotation, never a performance ranking.

flags.provenance: CRYPTO_BUILD_GIT_COMMIT pinned after implementation commit; clean=false prohibited

arms.description: Independent BSGS recovers the scalar from public inputs under the same bounded work budget; each recovery is checked with separate arithmetic.

flags.provenance: CRYPTO_BUILD_GIT_COMMIT pinned after implementation commit; clean=false prohibited

aa.not_applicable_reason: Exact fixture/data-integrity pilot with no timing comparison. Deterministic repeat and resume are implementation tests, not statistical A/A evidence.

positive.not_applicable_reason: No detection hypothesis. Native unit tests include known PDPs and full independent BSGS recovery; generator's known-answer scalar is verified separately for every constructed instance.

negative.not_applicable_reason: No discovery-rate or statistical significance claim. Wrong witnesses, corrupt artifacts, incorrect twist metadata and storage corruption are fail-closed software tests.

factors.name: source_binary
factors.how: Every run binds clean source commit, executable SHA256 and frozen plan; resume rejects changed binary.

factors.name: curve_generator_key
factors.how: Frozen deterministic axes and paired twists; same public input across backends.

factors.name: hardware_kernel_hypervisor_load
factors.how: Save host manifest. Shared Spot clocks are diagnostic, invalid for comparison.

factors.name: threads
factors.how: Child RAYON_NUM_THREADS=1, bounded process per cell.

factors.name: memory_environment_layout_order
factors.how: Record memory caps and native counters; no causal comparison from execution order.

factors.name: preemption
factors.how: Retain every attempt and immutable completed-cell publication; interrupted cell is preserved and requires reconciliation.

factors.name: analyst
factors.how: CLI hashes, verifies and counts statuses; no post-hoc significance test or hand-edited label.

variable_ledger.aa_not_applicable: Exact identity and artifact checks only; no timing/statistical comparison.

randomization.arm_order_reason: Reference BSGS and candidate solver cells follow the fixed mixed-radix method axis; no timing comparison.

seed_derivation.note: CaseConfig seed=20261027; independent curve/generator/key domains in pinned source. Plan mixed-radix rule frozen before data.

instance_sampling.rule: Synthetic known-answer targets over each certified prime subgroup; uniform nonzero rejection sampling and fixed curve-seed/generator/key axes. Retain all failed constructions.

blinding.how: Software validation has explicit method labels; public ML export must omit restricted witness/provenance and use field-size component holdout.

power.note: 72 distinct family/m/twist/generator/key configurations, 10 methods each =720 planned cells. No statistical inference; no claim of power. First launch is bounded to an explicitly recorded subset; remaining cells stay planned. Software preflight is excluded from the dataset and establishes no timing comparison.

preflight_runtime.measured_on: Local native unit calibration software-preflight.json: one n23 m2 Koblitz BSGS call and one enumerate call with FB4/work20000. 30s per cell and21600s total are conservative configured worker ceilings, not extrapolated measured runtimes; storage overhead is outside per-cell clocks and the job TTL bounds each wave.

primary.name: Verified records by distinct claim type
primary.definition: Count receipts whose independently replayed certificate establishes the specific known-answer, PDP or scalar claim; never combine these labels.
primary.source: cell manifest outcome and replay certificates

secondary.name: Typed native solver operation counters
secondary.definition: Counter names and scopes supplied by actual backend, with missing work explicit; never renamed as retired instructions or converted across methods.
secondary.source: solver outcome counters and per-event artifacts

stopping_rules.rule: At most720 planned pilot cells; each invocation explicitly names max_cases and disjoint shard binding. Initial wave at most36 cells per job, 3600s job TTL, 30s cell CPU-process wall deadline, 2048MiB address space and64MiB trace cap.
Stop publication wave on failed hash/replay/storage check; retain failed cell and all preceding receipts. Never change seeds to replace failure.

decision_rule.text: Report exact coverage and statuses; any incorrect verified label is an implementation failure to repair before scaling. A timeout, UNSAT report without proof or unsupported cell is not a mathematical conclusion.
decision_rule.threshold: zero invalid verified witnesses and zero missing/tampered published artifacts

inadmissible: claiming known-answer construction is an independent ECDLP solve
omitting unsupported cells or failed attempts
claiming native XOR counters are retired instructions
claiming observed solver degree is exact FFD or LFD
training on witnesses/seeds or splitting equivalent curve/twist instances across folds
calling an upload durable without readback
claiming a queued or partial wave completed the enormous corpus
